## Why visit

A first-rate destination for enthusiasts who value the drink itself: ten cask handpumps, a deliberate choice of dark ales and an unusually substantial cider/perry offer. The lively fox-and-pine-themed rooms provide a community-pub setting rather than a heritage showpiece. This was Rochdale, Oldham & Bury CAMRA's overall Pub of the Year 2026 and Greater Manchester runner-up, making Oldham a serious competing excursion to Stockport. The priority is a thoughtful tasting rather than forcing the visit into the main Manchester pub circuit.

## Beer

Ten cask handpumps, with bitter, pale and normally three dark beers represented. Draught Bass and changing regional guests feature in CAMRA's 2026 record. CAMRA names Durham, Mallinsons and Pictish among its changing brewers, alongside its Draught Bass offering; these are examples rather than November commitments.

## Cider and perry

**Real cider documented; reconfirm stock.** The local CAMRA branch describes five or six qualifying real ciders, often including perry, on gravity dispense from the cool room. Confirm producer and product.

See [how cider is classified](../real-cider.md).

## Plan the visit

An award-winning town-centre independent. The branch guide lists daily opening, but check November hours before the tram journey. Not a historic-interior destination.

**Getting there:** Oldham Central Metrolink is close; a focused Oldham excursion rather than a walking addition to central Manchester.
